profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Riot Games
profile.summary: Game engineer with extensive experience building AAA games, simulators, and live installations in a variety of genres and visual styles. Passionate about building playful, reactive, and deep worlds. Specializations: gameplay, systems, physics, simulations, and virtual reality.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Gameplay Framework Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Building the metaverse powered by Verse and UEFN. My team is at the center of many overlapping groups within Epic, empowering users of UEFN while setting up the future of Unreal Engine.

- I work closely with engine and design stakeholders to propose and build API's and features for UEFN. These designs often involve factoring in our own expertise in game development, balanced against the needs of our users and synergy with other metaverse APIs.
- Promote Verse usage within the company and help steer its design.
- Fix bugs in the engine framework and respond to users, contribute to best practices.
- Implement Verse features that expose useful parts of Unreal Engine to our UEFN users.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Unreal Engine · Game Programming · Multiplayer Games · Project Management · Game Engines · API Development

positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Gameplay engineering role with a heavy emphasis on systems. Some things I worked on include:
1. An animation selection system, which can rank animations based on what best fits the current gameplay situation.
2. Systems for first person shooter movement, auto aim, aim assist, and various kinds of vision augmentation for gameplay.
3. System for reactions within the world, such as explosions, electricity, heat, cold, etc, and a framework to track their performance, propagation, and authoring.
4. Performance and memory management, debug tools.

positions.title: Lead Gameplay Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Engineer on Oculus Quest launch title, Fujii. Also shipped on Rift and SteamVR. Work included program architecture, game-play scripting, and visual effects. Special work included developing a multi-threaded soft-body physics engine to add a level of interactivity and reactivity to the plants and puzzles in the game world.

Unity3D, C#, C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building virtual and augmented reality experiences and installations. Platforms include: Vive, Oculus, PS4, and Apple's ARKit. Worked on every element of the experiences, from physics and rendering to networking and distribution. Heavy emphasis on gameplay and network programming.

positions.title: Lead Game Engineer
positions.description: Lead engineer on games for Desktop/Mobile using Unity3D.

positions.title: Student Researcher/Developer
positions.description: Worked with Unity3D to create a networked multiplayer game where users can use Microsoft Kinect to manipulate digital toys. The purpose is to investigate creative play, and build an artificial intelligence that can play with a human being.

positions.title: Student Augmented Reality Researcher
positions.description: Worked on software and hardware interfaces for writing interactive augmented and virtual reality applications.

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Introduction to Object Oriented Programming course. Tasked with managing several TA's and designing/maintaining course elements.

positions.title: Student Java Programmer
positions.description:
Quantum Computer Simulation Programming: Java, C++, ANTLR.
Programmed and helped design a Java IDE for controlling quantum bits by compiling and running Java code in real-time. Worked in a group and had strong creative control over code, tasked with self-managing tasks and goals.
